ENTIA / PRACTICE

Welcome to the Veil

Defeat a rival, pick up its essence, then deposit it at the shrine. Secure 60 to complete the demo.

1. Fight

Press C to prepare Apocalipsis, then point and click a rival. Prepare again for each cast. Move away from enemy spell markers.

2. Collect

Stand on a dropped crystal and press Q. If you die, your carried essence drops at that spot and can be recovered.

3. Deposit

The shrine appears after your first pickup, south of the return portal. Stay nearby for a moment and watch essence flow into storage. Walk away to stop the transfer.

Auto-potions are enabled initially: life at 50%, mana at 30%. Each run starts with 10 of each. Toggle them in the character panel or click a potion in Inventory to use one.

On a phone, use the directional pad, Prepare button and contextual pickup button. Open Character for your inventory and resources.

This is an offline demonstration. Rewards, combat and essence rules are illustrative; nothing affects your RAO account.
